name: PIN Format 3 Code
definition: PIN (Personal Identification Number) format used before encryption.

ISO0.name: ISO 0
ISO0.definition: PIN diversified with the card account number, conforming to the standard ISO 9564-2.

ISO1.name: ISO 1
ISO1.definition: PIN completed with random padding characters, conforming to the standard ISO 9564-2.

ISO2.name: ISO 2
ISO2.definition: PIN without diversification characters, conforming to the standard ISO 9564-2.

ISO3.name: ISO 3
ISO3.definition: PIN diversified with the card account number and random characters, conforming to the standard ISO 9564-2.

ISO4.name: ISO 4
ISO4.definition: PIN format used with AES encryption, conforming to the new ISO SC2 format.

ISO5.name: ISO 5
ISO5.definition: Alternative PIN format used with AES encryption, conforming to the new ISO SC2 format.
